headerDisplay: The **SwitchBot** plugin allows you to control SwitchBot Devices. Use the hybrid client (BLE + OpenAPI) or only OpenAPI by supplying an Open Token.
footerDisplay: Please raise any issues on our [project page](https://github.com/OpenWonderLabs/homebridge-switchbot/issues).

openApiToken.title: OpenAPI Token
openApiToken.description: SwitchBot OpenAPI token used as a fallback when BLE isn't available. Keep this secret.

openApiSecret.title: OpenAPI Secret (optional)
openApiSecret.description: Optional OpenAPI secret for certain account setups.

enableBLE.title: Enable BLE (Bluetooth)
enableBLE.description: Enable or disable BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) support. If disabled, only OpenAPI (cloud) will be used.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: List of SwitchBot devices to manage. Use the UI to add devices and copy device IDs.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable this device without removing it from the config.

configDeviceName.title: Name
configDeviceName.description: Friendly name for this device as shown in HomeKit/Matter.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: The SwitchBot device identifier (MAC or SwitchBot Cloud deviceId). Use the plugin UI to copy this.

configDeviceType.title: Device Type
configDeviceType.description: Select the device type so the plugin can expose the correct HomeKit/Matter services and characteristics.
enum: Robot Vacuum Cleaner K10+ Pro Combo
Robot Vacuum Cleaner K20 Plus Pro

connectionPreference.title: Connection Preference
connectionPreference.description: Select whether this device should prefer BLE, OpenAPI, or auto-detect (hybrid).

externalPublishProtocol.title: Publish as External Device
externalPublishProtocol.description: Publish this device as an external accessory for a specific protocol. Select HAP or Matter to expose it externally, or None to keep normal platform publishing.

room.title: Room
room.description: Optional room/location metadata for the device.

encryptionKey.title: BLE Encryption Key
encryptionKey.description: (Advanced) Optional BLE encryption key for this device. Required for some locks, relays, air purifiers, and light strips. See plugin docs for how to obtain this key.

keyId.title: BLE Key ID
keyId.description: (Advanced) Optional BLE key ID for this device (usually 2 hex characters, e.g. 'ff'). Only required for some locks.

refreshRate.title: OpenAPI Polling Interval (seconds)
refreshRate.description: How often to poll this device via OpenAPI for status (in seconds). Overrides platform value if set. Default: 300 (5 minutes). Minimum: 30.

openApiRefreshRate.title: OpenAPI Polling Interval (seconds)
openApiRefreshRate.description: How often to poll devices via OpenAPI for status (in seconds). Default: 300 (5 minutes). Minimum: 30. Can be overridden per device.

matterBatchEnabled.title: Enable Batched OpenAPI Polling
matterBatchEnabled.description: If enabled, the platform will poll all OpenAPI devices in a single batch at the configured interval. Devices with per-device refreshRate are excluded from the batch.

matterBatchRefreshRate.title: OpenAPI Batch Polling Interval (seconds)
matterBatchRefreshRate.description: Interval for batched OpenAPI polling (in seconds). Falls back to openApiRefreshRate if not set. Default: 300.

dailyApiLimit.title: OpenAPI Daily Request Limit
dailyApiLimit.description: Maximum OpenAPI requests per day allowed by the plugin. Default: 10000.

dailyApiReserveForCommands.title: OpenAPI Reserve for Commands
dailyApiReserveForCommands.description: Requests reserved for user actions (commands/webhooks). When remaining budget reaches this value, background polling pauses. Default: 1000.

dailyApiResetLocalMidnight.title: Reset OpenAPI Counter at Local Midnight
dailyApiResetLocalMidnight.description: If true, resets the daily OpenAPI request counter at local midnight. If false, resets at UTC midnight.

webhookOnlyOnReserve.title: Only Allow Webhooks on Reserve
webhookOnlyOnReserve.description: When remaining OpenAPI budget reaches the reserve, only webhooks and user commands are allowed. Background polling/discovery pauses.

matterBatchConcurrency.title: OpenAPI Batch Concurrency
matterBatchConcurrency.description: Maximum number of parallel OpenAPI status calls during a batch. Default: 5.

matterBatchJitter.title: OpenAPI Batch Jitter (seconds)
matterBatchJitter.description: Random startup delay before the first batch to reduce synchronized spikes. Default: 0.

enableMatter.title: Enable Matter Support (Override)
enableMatter.description: Manually enable Matter support. By default, Matter is auto-detected from the child bridge configuration. Only change this if you need to override the auto-detection.

preferMatter.title: Prefer Matter when available
preferMatter.description: If enabled and Matter is available, devices will be presented as Matter accessories where supported (instead of HAP).

blePollingEnabled.title: Enable BLE Polling Fallback
blePollingEnabled.description: If enabled, the plugin will periodically poll BLE devices for status as a safety net in addition to real-time notifications. This helps recover from missed notifications or connection loss. Recommended for reliability. Can be overridden per device.

blePollIntervalMs.title: BLE Polling Interval (ms)
blePollIntervalMs.description: How often to poll BLE devices for status (in milliseconds). Default is 600000 (10 minutes). Set higher to reduce battery drain. Minimum 60000 (1 minute). Can be overridden per device.
